mustFix.problem: An unstyled browser-default 'Next' button (~24px tall) renders beside the styled Back/Next pair; the styled pair appears not to be wired to the form module, and Back shows on step 1. Primary conversion is confusing and fails the 48px tap target on phone.
mustFix.fix: Wire the styled buttons with the hooks the form module expects (data-back / data-next instead of data-form-prev / data-form-next) so the module does not inject its own; hide Back on step 1; show Send request only on the last step. Re-shoot 390-full and check.

elevate.move: Make the quote form a phone-first stepper in the schedule's language: each step a day card from the coat sheet, progress shown as the film-build stripe gaining a layer per step, sticky bar hidden while the form is on screen.

Commit to one mark system: every label, Sample tag, area chip and step number becomes a 2px stamped tag sharing one rule weight with the film stripe and cards, so every detail reads as the same printed schedule.
